findings.title: Covenant binds against encircling loss
findings.claim: Across the pericope, a human guarding claim is given binding form by the covenant, while the exception of encirclement keeps that bond from becoming a claim of mastery over every enclosing force.
findings.mechanism: The brothers' promise to guard meets the focus's binding pledge, protective and overpowering enclosure branches, and final trustee predicate; the contacts make custody answerable while preserving an external limit on its efficacy.
findings.reader_payoff: The pledge becomes visible as a bounded custody structure: a cord of obligation set against loss, with divine trusteeship marking the limit of human guarding.
findings.containment: This does not claim that the pledge guarantees return, that the exception is only physical encirclement, or that the guarding branch is an independent lexical translation of the focus form. The preserving branch is nominated channel evidence and remains qualified.

epistemic.reason: The channel and its branch nominations are trusted and locally landed, but the preserving branch is supplied as a nominated source image rather than a focus lexical registry branch.

findings.title: Measured provision becomes performance security
findings.claim: The focus covenant can be read as performance security within a measured provisioning exchange: arrival earns provision, nonarrival withholds access, and the pledge formalizes the return performance required for the exchange.
findings.mechanism: The context ties full measure to bringing the brother, states no measure and no access when he is not brought, and repeats the arrival root in the focus before the brothers deliver the covenant.
findings.reader_payoff: The pledge becomes a concrete exchange instrument rather than private reassurance alone.
findings.containment: The trade condition may motivate the journey without defining the pledge; this finding therefore describes a pericope-level performance relation, not the sole meaning of the focus covenant.

epistemic.reason: The exact Arabic anchors and HFT trace are supplied, but the source record is legacy-unbound and the two non-focus branch identities remain unresolved.

findings.containment: The later legal episode may be a narrative parallel rather than a semantic unfolding of the focus; this does not claim that speech alone causes capture or that every utterance creates law.

findings.title: Enclosure becomes a custody mechanism
findings.claim: As an exploratory structural echo, later baggage and vessel mechanics make enclosure perceptible as a process in which contained evidence can close around people and terminate ordinary return obligations.
findings.mechanism: The focus supplies literal surrounding, while 12:70 places the object in a saddle-load and 12:76 moves from vessels to extraction and capture; the sequence turns containment into a route toward custody.
findings.reader_payoff: The exception gains a material analogue: what surrounds is not only a condition but a mechanism that can alter who is able to return.
findings.containment: This is a surprising pericope-level structural echo. It does not claim that يُحَاطَ means luggage, vessel, or legal detention, and it does not displace the primary reading of overwhelming enclosure.

epistemic.reason: The exact anchors and trace are supplied, but the HFT source is legacy-unbound and the relation is explicitly form- and sequence-distant.

findings.title: Speech shoulders the custody burden
findings.claim: At the level of latent wordplay, the focus's repeated saying can be felt as the act by which the speakers lift and shoulder the transport-and-custody burden attached to their promise.
findings.mechanism: The focus repeats speech around the sending transaction, while 12:72 places a load beside explicit surety; the carrying-and-rising branch therefore contacts the speech sequence as an image of assumed responsibility.
findings.reader_payoff: The words become bodily and practical: saying is not only recording terms but taking up the weight of what those terms require.
findings.containment: This is form-distant and exploratory. It uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ل mapping and does not make the carrying branch the lexical translation of نَقُولُ.
